title: No support for in-line skating
body:
Would you imagine that company like Apple ignore In-line skating? For ages. No option to record this kind of exercise. My week report is rubbish.

title: Workout monthly challenge withou access to fitness+
body:
I really like this app, I do despite sometimes having issues tracking progress for monthly challenges. 
Now the issue I have at this point, I have a monthly challenge for a workout. The problem is I don’t have fitness+.
There are two issues I have with it.
First, in my country there is no support for fitness+. It is not like I don’t workout, this part of app is not supported here.
Second, the app suppose to create challenges based on my activities. As I can’t have fitness+, I never did any workout based on this app. So where this challenge came from?
